items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 83:1
items.html: There are no Klipot except from the discernment of the fall to BYA, and therefore there are no Klipot opposite the GAR, because even in the breaking of the vessels only the seven lower Sefirot of Nekudim went out to BYA. But from the backs of Keter and AVI and YESHSUT of Nekudim nothing fell to the Klipot; rather, they remained in Atzilut, in the place of ZON, and there was only an annulment in them, by reason of their fall from a head to a body. For everything that remains in Atzilut has no discernment of Klipa there, God forbid, as it is written, "no evil shall dwell with You."
